properties.evidence: crates/reflow2-core/src/reasoning.rs (main 5a94e83): reasoning_roots inserts the conclusion of every Inference that is a premise of none, plus every contested Decision. reasoning_neighbours follows a claim's concluding steps to their premises, INCOMING opposing CONTRADICTS (objections against this claim), and contested governance. Nothing follows an OUTGOING opposing CONTRADICTS from an objection to its target. A conjecture is concluded by no step and is no step's premise, so neither rule reaches it.
